SCL_Oliver_Dog
Doggy is a unique Construct in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in the service of the curse-bound child  Oliver. Despite appearing as a Shadow and having similar abilities to a  Shadow Mastiff, it is a construct, not an undead or a monstrosity.

Overview

'Doggy' appears during the second game of hide-and-seek with Oliver, requiring the party to  Hide if they wish to avoid a fight. It also enters them into Turn-Based Mode. The party must then either sneak their way into the ruined house where Oliver reappears in two turns or attempt to fight the construct which is backed up by  'Mummy' and  'Daddy'.
